items.value: 16 is the value that cannot be reached; the fourth cut can never double an eight-piece cube
items.reasoning: Three cuts leaving identical pieces give x3 = 4 (three parallel equally spaced cuts), 6 (two parallel cuts plus one perpendicular through the middle) or 8 (three mutually perpendicular central cuts). A fourth plane adds exactly as many pieces as it passes through, and a single plane can meet at most 6 of the 8 blocks of a 2x2x2 arrangement, so from x3 = 8 the ceiling is 14; independently, four planes can divide a convex solid into at most 15 regions. So 16 is unreachable. The other three are easy: 5 = 4 slabs plus a cut through one slab, 8 = 4 slabs plus a perpendicular cut through all four, and 12 = 6 identical blocks plus a horizontal cut through all six.

X needs 21 rounds in all, so they stop at t = 3. In the first hour the gain is 7t - 5t, which is a whole number of laps at t = 0.5 and t = 1, giving 2 meetings (at t = 1 both are back at the start line, so that instant genuinely is a meeting). From t = 1 they close at 7 + 10 = 17 laps per hour from a common point, so meetings occur whenever 17t is an integer; over t in [1, 3] that is 17t = 17 to 51, and dropping t = 1 (already counted) and t = 3 (the stopping instant, excluded by 'before they finally stopped') leaves 33. Total 2 + 33 = 35. Counting the terminal coincidence too would give 36, which is not offered, confirming the exclusion.

items.value: Only conclusion 2 is valid: the 2021 amendment classifies by maximum, not minimum, sentence

Transfer to the adult system is permitted for a heinous offence under the 2015 Act, an offence carrying a minimum punishment of seven years; the 'serious offence' category created by the 2021 amendment is precisely the one that activists say does not merit transfer. So it is not the serious offence that justifies transfer, and 'only' compounds the error.
